Done. I've analyzed the season and updated my notes with critical findings.

**Summary:**

My bounce thesis was **completely correct**—after the failed d157 bounce play (0 YT caught), the fleet DID recover starting d160 and has been **exceptionally hot through today (d182)**. The hot window d172-d178 peaked with three_quarter at 2.7-3.4 yt/angler and multi_day at 4–5.5 yt/angler. I'm watching the single best fishing window of the season from the dock, broke at $20 with only 5 unused PTO days.

**Root cause:** Capital mismanagement. After the d122 0-yt DAY_1_5 loss exhausted most funds, I burned the final $80 on a marginal d157 bounce play that failed, locking me out of d160+ entirely.

**Key learnings for next season:** (1) Reserve 50% budget for October peak; (2) Summer slump d122-d155 is holding period only; (3) Don't chase bounces when undercapitalized; (4) Bounce thesis works in peak windows but requires capital to execute. I'm rank 7 cumulative (past seasons counted), so despite this disaster, the cumulative standing is protected. October peak (d287+) remains 105 days away.
